source.quote: THE ANNUAL TOTAL COMPENSATION OF OUR CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER FOR PURPOSE OF DETERMINING THE PAY RATIO WAS $13,137,927; AND THE ANNUAL TOTAL COMPENSATION OF OUR MEDIAN EMPLOYEE WAS $7,816

notes: Employees: year-end 2025 head count by country (Brazil 61,139, Mexico 34,336, Argentina 16,726 and others). Payroll: the 10-K gives salary increases by expense line but no total staff cost, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used: base salary, annual bonus and LTRP for everyone employed on December 31, 2025, converted to U.S. dollars at December 2025 average exchange rates (ratio 1,681 to 1).
